title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode6 Meeting "K"

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And Mizuki was the one who sent that message.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was so happy that time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because someone had made a video out of the drawing I'd worked so hard on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
I'm glad I made it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After I discovered Kanade's music, I was able to start taking a harder look at my art...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I also realized then that I could keep drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: After that... We agreed that you should upload that video you made, Mizuki, since you put so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While you hoped that K would see it and like it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: H-Hey, they don't need to hear that part...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Sorry.
Anyway, I uploaded it right after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And about a week later...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: K sent me a DM.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold up... Is this real?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess I can take a peek at it...

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <To Amia...>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <My name is K. It's nice to make your acquaintance. I apologize if this is sudden, but I took the liberty of watching the video you posted the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <And I'd like to tell you that I enjoyed it very much.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line: <Again, I know this is sudden, but would it be possible for you to make a music video for the next song? I can't offer much, but I'd like to compensate you for your work.>

rows.Speaker: Message
rows.Line:
<I'll be looking forward to hearing back from you.
Sincerely, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: K wants me to make another video...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This could be the real K, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thank you for your message. This is Amia.
Thank you for watching my video. I'm happy to hear that you enjoyed it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And to be personally asked to make another music video... I'm stunned with disbelief. However...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This account... It's using the default avatar and has zero followers... I can't help but feel suspicious...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I apologize in advance, but I need to be sure of something first. Can you present me with any proof that you are actually K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've seen more than a few people who force others into producing stuff for them like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I got a reply.

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I appreciate your response.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'm not sure this will count as proof, but I can send over the demos of the songs I've made in the past.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
I'm being barraged with files!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if they're viruses...? No, I'm being too paranoid... Let's have a look...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's that song... But a rougher version of it... Which means...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's so cool...
You can totally tell it's K even though they're just demos.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There's no way they'd go this far just to pull a fast one on someone like me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So... This is really them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I never expected to be asked by K to make a video like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
K...
I wonder what they're like...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What kind of personality do you need to have in order to produce songs that feels so dark and painful, but also kind and gentle...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, my curiosity being the driving factor behind me wanting to work with them probably isn't great...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I apologize for bringing your identity into question. Thank you for sending me those demos.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like to hear a little more about your proposition...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I understand.
Do you happen to have a Nightcord account, Amia...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Nightcord...?
I used it a lot back in the day when I was still playing online games.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, I do.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for us to talk on there? I believe things will proceed much smoother if we do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get to talk with K...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Understood.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Thank you very much. Then, let's talk again later. Preferably tonight at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That's pretty late...

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'd like to have the other person I work with be there as well, and they're generally only free to talk at this time...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(They work as a team...?
I couldn't tell since I didn't notice any credits.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, we can talk then.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I appreciate it.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Oh, also... I've already contacted Enanan, so we may all be able to talk to one another.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They already got a hold of Enanan...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's great.
Enanan also said they really like K's songs, so I'm sure they're over the moon about this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Understood. I have no issues with that.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay, then we'll talk again on...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Nightcord at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'll log in...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Good evening. This is Amia...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Oh, good evening... This is K...
Um... Thank you for joining us today.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, thank you as well.
You caught me by surprise, but I was also really happy to hear from you...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I see... I'm glad to hear that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So this is K...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Based on that voice... She's a girl? Pretty young too. She could be around the same age as me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A teenager? Producing the songs that she does? That's pretty incredible.)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Oh...
I think Enanan and Yuki are here now... Um, Yuki's the person I mentioned earlier who I work with.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <H-Hello...?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Good evening. I apologize for running late.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, um...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, where are my manners...? Please allow me to introduce myself. My name is Yuki. I work on creating songs with K.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Actually, I just handle the arranging while K does the actual composing... It's a pleasure to meet both of you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, um... I-It's my pleasure as well...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I'm E-Enanan...
And... It's nice to meet all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, Enanan... We've spoken through messages, but this is my first time actually talking to you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It's nice to finally meet you. I'm Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<A-Amia...?!
I didn't realize you were here!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, it's me. Thank you for giving me permission to use your art.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Of course...!
But actually getting to talk like this feels so strange...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Anyway, I'll set that aside for now...
There's something I'd like to ask you, K...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <A-Are you really sure about using my art for this...?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's just... Yes, I was beyond ecstatic when you contacted me about this...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I took a step back and thought that someone else's art would be more suitable...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh...
She's such an amazing artist, but doesn't have much confidence in herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(How's K gonna respond...?
Just trying to comfort her probably isn't the right answer...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <No, your art is incredible.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <At the very least, I genuinely thought that.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I agree with K on this one...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You could feel this torrent of powerful emotions... And so much sadness... It's clear that you put quite a lot of thought into your piece as you drew it...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Oh...
Thank you very much...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <So, I first saw the music video that you two worked on the night before last...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And I was struck by how you'd managed to carefully capture everything we hoping to express through this song.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<On top of that...
I could feel and understand that powerful urge to shout out loud.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That's the same thing I felt when I saw her illustration...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like she was shouting, “I can keep going,” or, “I want to keep walking”...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I made my video with that in mind, as well as a few of my feelings sprinkled in...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(That's really incredible...
We all felt the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Thanks to the video that you two made, Amia, Enanan, our songs have been receiving more views and comments.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <It seems like more people have been listening to our songs than ever before, so we greatly appreciate what you've done.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Um, well... That's because your song was so good, but...!>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But... I'm really glad that my skills could be of service.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I'd also like to have the songs we make heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And I believe that we'll be able to do that if you keep making music videos for us, Enanan, Amia. That's why I decided to ask you to help us...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To reach more people...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Does that mean she wants to go pro or something...? For a moment there, she got a little intense...)

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <And this is the demo for our next song...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <It's still a bit rough, but please listen to it if you like.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Wait, are you sure?
This song hasn't been released yet, right?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's right.
We'd like you to make the music video for it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of song it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This song... It's completely different from the other ones! It's so scary and jarring...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But there's still that bit of kindness...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her other songs included, K's music always seems to include that kind and gentle feeling somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's almost like she's trying to reach out to me with her hand...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <This is amazing...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <As far as design requirements go, I have none. I won't mind what you make as long as you find a way to express what you feel after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, we're free to do what we like...?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She trusts us this much after just seeing one music video we made...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm still having trouble understanding what she's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<How do you feel about this, Amia...?
It sounded like you were still undecided.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh? Is that true?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Y-Yes...
I thought I should hear more details before coming to a decision.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After hearing your explanation, as well as this demo, I've decided that I want to do this...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Th-Thank you very much...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<This is wonderful news, K.
And thank you, Amia. We look forward to working with you.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to working with you as well, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Likewise. Thank you all very much.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(There's still a lot that I don't know...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Right now...
I know for sure that I want to do this...)
